title: Lester's drinking and why he was misunderstood
summary: Lester was always a heavy drinker, and rivals misunderstood him.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Even then, as early as when you first met him, he already was a heavy drinker?
Oh, ho-ho-ho-ho... I never saw anybody drink like that in my life.
Because a lot of people think he didn't really start until after he had that unfortunate experience in the Army and all that.

No-no. He went in the Army drunk. Marvelous, marvelous, marvelous... If I were to see him, if he were to walk in here this day, I'd kiss him and hug him. 'Cause I loved him. Everybody loved him. Everybody that knew him loved him. You had to understand him. These other guys that would come out there with blood in their eye, ready to blow him out because he didn't play like Hawkins, they didn't understand him. They didn't know what kind of a person... He was a different person.

You know, it's like when you're in high school and there's the guy with the glasses in the corner that always gets Straight-A in Science, and everybody puts him away, you know, and they won't talk to him and all that -- they don't

know how brilliant he is. I went to high school with a guy like that. I didn't talk to him... You couldn't talk to him. He was fifteen-twenty yards away from you before you had mentioned(?)... That's the way Lester was.
